name: Beta Drugs Ltd
business_description: Beta Drugs Ltd manufactures a wide range of oncology (anti-cancer) drugs, supplying both the domestic Indian market and export markets. The company generates revenue by producing and selling these pharmaceutical formulations to hospitals, pharmacies, and distributors.
input_sensitivity: Cost risks: Margins are sensitive to prices of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), solvents, packaging materials, energy, and labor costs. Revenue/demand risks: Demand is directly driven by cancer incidence rates, healthcare infrastructure spending, and government procurement policies in both domestic and export markets.
output_note: Hospitals, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical distributors directly pay Beta Drugs Ltd for oncology (anti-cancer) drug formulations.
